content.text:
Some of factorio's settings are not stored in any config file on this server — they are read from the environment when the game starts, and the only place an instance can set them is .grizzly/env, at the top of the data directory. It is always there, often empty. Don't go looking for a config file for these: there isn't one, and searching for it is time spent on something that cannot be found.

Exactly these settings do anything in that file, and the rest are ignored: LOAD_LATEST_SAVE and SAVE_NAME. A line naming anything else is dropped when the game launches, so the change will look like it worked and won't have.

Read the file first to see what's already set, then change it like any other config file — one setting at a time — and restart to apply it. That restart self-guards: if the game refuses a value and won't start, the previous version of the file is restored and the server restarted automatically, and you'll be told. So a value you're unsure of is worth trying rather than talking around; afterwards, read_logs to confirm it took rather than assuming.

There is no supported way to install mods on factorio through this bot — no registry is wired up for it, so there is nothing to search and nothing to write. Say so plainly. Don't improvise an install by hand through the file tools: anything put there that way is outside everything that would otherwise check it and put it back. If someone wants mods on this game, escalate it as a feature request.

I found the problem. Factorio quits right at startup because the **robo-helpers** mod needs another mod, **nanobots-core** (version 1.0.0 or newer), and it isn't installed. The log says: `Failed to load mod "robo-helpers": Missing required dependency nanobots-core >= 1.0.0`. The server has restarted itself twice and keeps hitting the same error.

I tried to switch robo-helpers back off in the server's mod list (`mods/mod-list.json`), but both attempts failed. I can't install mods on Factorio servers, so I can't add nanobots-core either. I've passed this to a human. They can either turn robo-helpers off so the server starts as it did before, or install nanobots-core if you want to keep the mod.

Nothing has been deleted. Your save file and the mod's files are still on the server. If you want to keep robo-helpers, reply here so the person picking this up knows to install nanobots-core rather than turn the mod off.
input.reason: Factorio 2.0.77 server is crash-looping (2 crash restarts) at mod load: `Failed to load mod "robo-helpers": Missing required dependency nanobots-core >= 1.0.0`. mods/ contains robo-helpers_1.2.0 and tidy-signs_0.4.1 (unpacked dirs). mods/mod-list.json only lists base/elevated-rails/quality/space-age, so robo-helpers is enabled by default because it isn't listed. Fix options: add {"name":"robo-helpers","enabled":false} to mod-list.json (restores previous working state), or install nanobots-core >= 1.0.0. I tried the first via edit_file twice. Both times it returned "not found", even though cat -A shows old_text matching exactly (an identical-text no-op edit confirmed the file path resolves). I suspect edits under mods/ are blocked or the tool has a bug. Per the game guide there's no supported mod path for factorio, so I stopped there. No backup on record and I couldn't take one because the server is crash-looping. 1 save exists in saves/.
